recipes.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all the ingredients and mix well.
Optionally, spoon a little peanut butter into the jars and swirl it around the inside.
Divide the oat mixture between the jars, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, add your desired toppings, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use 50 - 60% cacao chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter.
Storage Store in the fridge for up to 3 days.
